images.subject: A prototype shield generator: one compact machine projecting a large bright dome of force field over itself.
images.detail: The dome is a clearly visible glowing violet energy shell with a bright luminous rim and a faint hexagonal pattern across its whole surface, and an incoming energy bolt bursts into bright ripples against its outer surface.

images.subject: A prototype shield generator: one compact machine projecting a large bright dome of force field over itself.
images.detail: The dome is a thick glowing shell of violet energy, tinted violet all over and clearly visible against the dark hall, with a blazing bright rim where it meets the bench and a glowing hexagonal pattern across its whole surface, and an incoming energy bolt bursts into bright ripples against its outer surface.

images.subject: A prototype shield generator: one compact machine projecting a large bright dome of force field over itself.
images.detail: The machine sits fully inside the dome and is seen through its translucent violet near side: the front of the glowing violet energy shell passes in front of the machine, and the dome base forms a bright glowing ring on the bench all around the machine, in front of it and behind it.
